note: A bind replayed under a pick threw noSuccessfulBranch while the same bind replayed alone succeeded. Replay's pick path unwraps branch subtrees through replayChoices(for:), but the bind case handed innerTree in as a single opaque choice, starving an inner generator that consumes more than one. Only the pick path reaches that code; the standalone path uses replayRecursive's separate bind case. Fixed 2026-08-01 in 5a832f066 by unwrapping a plain wrapper group the same way branch subtrees are unwrapped. Found by the 2026-07-31 depth-3 campaign.
